Package paint.shared.io

Class MainIOInterface

java.lang.Object
paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface
public final class MainIOInterface extends Object
Provides a high-level API (façade) for reading and writing all core PAINT data tables (Experiment Info, Recordings, Squares, and Tracks).

The MainIOInterface serves as the primary entry point for I/O operations. It coordinates between high-level model requests and low-level Tablesaw-based implementations found in the internal package. It handles path resolution, schema extraction from enums, and error logging.

  • Centralized access for all CSV table operations.
  • Automated schema management using entity Column enums.
  • Standardized error reporting via PaintLogger.
  • Support for both project-level and experiment-level I/O.
